rationale: P characterises whether vehicle braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended—the behaviour directly required to evaluate T and safety goal SG-3. Its operational scope is explicitly supported by H-3, whose hazardous event is sudden stopping without an obstacle ahead. Braking behaviour itself is therefore legitimately part of P. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking behavior is the phenomenon being characterised, directly matching the subject of T.
The scope includes whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended.
The operational conditions—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, good weather, and no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead—are specified in H-3.
